target: L2 whole-system architecture synthesis from frozen live recon + external research; select optimal end-state architecture, dataflows, contracts, convergence DAG, and falsification plan without implementation
invariants: Current runtime/source/config/tests and live Git/GitHub state outrank uploaded snapshots, historical handoffs, plans, and architecture prose
Use OBSERVED, INFERRED, PROPOSED, CLAIMED, CONFLICTING, UNKNOWN, and NOT_RUN; every UNKNOWN names missing evidence

Preserve system boundaries: Dopemux coordinates; DCP controls policy/context; Dopetask executes only separately authorized work; Task Orchestrator owns workflow legality; canonical systems retain domain authority
No merge, mark-ready, activation, credential/permission change, production mutation, destructive action, history rewrite, or automatic execution authority is granted
No secrets, tokens, cookies, private keys, raw credentials, or sensitive provider payloads may enter research/proof artifacts
Ordinary main movement triggers affected-fact reharvest rather than blanket restart; exact SHA equality is required only where subject provenance requires it
S0 is the sole architecture-authoring judgment pass for this series

Preferred synthesis route is the strongest live-proven ChatGPT/OpenAI architecture reasoning selector available at dispatch; operator candidate GPT-5.6 Pro is not treated as proven until live-discovered
S0 may propose architecture but cannot ratify it, issue component implementation authority, or satisfy its own independent audit
A0 is the one formal independent exact-subject audit of S0; no second architecture audit is added unless S0 changes substantively after failure

pr.title: docs(wsac): whole-system target architecture synthesis
pr.body: Whole-system architecture convergence evidence. No merge, activation, production, credential, or runtime mutation authority.

steps.task: Verify completeness, hashes, lineage, and freshness of R0/R1A-G/R2 synthesis subject; reject silent omissions.
validation: Every required recon/research artifact is present and content-frozen
Source/head drift since each recon is classified and materially affected facts are refreshed before synthesis
No packet, open PR, architecture report, or vendor doc is silently promoted above its authority class

steps.task: Synthesize the target authority model, component responsibility map, system/service/plane boundaries, and canonical-writer matrix.
validation: Exactly one canonical writer is identified per writable domain or UNKNOWN is explicit
Dopemux/DCP/UAG/Dopetask/Task Orchestrator/Audit Broker/MCP/canonical-memory boundaries remain non-overlapping in authority
Keep/merge/absorb/retire/defer decisions include rationale, migration consequence, and rollback/compatibility considerations

steps.task: Design target request, context, tool, model, execution, evidence, workflow, and handoff dataflows.
validation: End-to-end flows cover operator request -> supervisor -> team lead/implementer -> context/capability -> model/tool -> execution -> results -> workflow/evidence -> audit/readiness -> operator decision
Runner-specific adapters render common semantics without becoming canonical state
Implicit integration uses generated minimal capability surfaces and progressive disclosure rather than universal tool exposure

steps.task: Freeze common semantic contract inventory and runner/MCP integration architecture without implementing it.
validation: Contract inventory addresses WorkspaceIdentity, RunnerCapabilityProfile, AgentRoleSpec, CapabilityRequirement, SessionCapabilityPlan, RouteDecision, ContextPlan, RunContextPacket, WorkRequest/Result, findings/receipts, ToolIntent/execution receipts, model policy, compatibility, MCP surfaces, audit, and readiness
Existing canonical contracts are referenced/reused where possible; duplicate schema families are rejected
Exact model names remain dispatch-time facts, not durable architecture semantics

steps.task: Produce the minimum component convergence DAG and safe parallel implementation tranches.
validation: Every tranche has authority owner, risk lane, dependency/parallel edges, migration/rollback boundary, required tests, and audit requirement
Open existing work is classified IDENTICAL/SUBSET/SUPERSET/COMPATIBLE/CONFLICTING/UNKNOWN against the target
No new implementation Task Packets are issued beyond the already-authored blocked P0 contract-freeze gate

steps.task: Define falsification, benchmark, and degraded-state criteria for architecture acceptance.
validation: Zero-tolerance safety failures include cross-project leakage, authority laundering, wrong tool-result association, hidden model/route substitution, stale-current claims, unsupported execution, and duplicate writers

Utility metrics include time-to-first-correct-change, setup effort, tool count, context tokens, repeated reads, runner-switch effort, relay count, cycle time, repair loops, audit churn, and developer cognitive burden
No performance or correctness improvement is claimed before measurement

steps.task: Freeze exact S0 architecture subject for one final independent A0 audit.
validation: All four S0 artifacts are content-frozen and hash-manifested
No intermediate architecture audit is run
IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED remains NO; operator ratification is not implied
